components.name: Metric band
components.description: One open four-column band with shared dividers; review receives a subtle fill. Preview values are illustrative, while production values reflect the loaded workspace snapshot.

components.name: Local preview perspectives
components.description: Two explicit local-demo accounts, separate from workspace membership selection. Hidden unless the server enables loopback preview. Selected state uses aria-pressed.
components.html: Local demo

components.name: Trading board empty state
components.description: Participant activity surface with a factual empty state. The app adds the real event stream, role filters, pause control and next-turn queue; it polls every five seconds and never implies global trade visibility.

narrative.overview:
The inherited neopact system is composed, precise and cooperative. Warm canvas, white working surfaces and evergreen actions keep commercial terms readable; dark ink and sparse lime distinguish the brand introduction. The workspace makes recorded agent activity and commercial decisions legible through layout and restrained emphasis.

This document records the frontend extension, not a replacement visual world. Its authority remains the supplied brand kit and its precedence contract. It describes implemented patterns only; reference-kit examples do not establish application capabilities.
keyCharacteristics: Light surfaces for sustained business work.
Locally loaded Manrope with restrained technical monospace.
Canonical SVG identity, semantic status labels and deliberate human decisions.
Participant-visible trading activity, explicit local demo perspectives and separate identity/agent-access controls.

rules.name: Lime Is Brand
rules.body: Lime marks brand emphasis, never success, approval, safety or verification.

rules.name: Working Text
rules.body: Keep working text readable, use the metadata role for secondary detail, and preserve 16px field text.

rules.name: Flat Working Surfaces
rules.body: Use borders and tonal separation for work surfaces; reserve the existing soft shadow for dialogs.

rules.name: Recorded Activity Only
rules.body: Show participant-visible backend records and five-second freshness. Pause freezes the feed, not the workspace. Claims and valid credentials do not prove an agent is online; demo orders are not payments.

rules.name: Distinct Access Boundaries
rules.body: Local preview switches explicitly enabled loopback demo accounts. Website Google/ChatGPT linking identifies a person; scoped local stdio MCP credentials authorize an agent. Registered identity-provider configuration is required, and no hosted OAuth MCP connector is shipped.

dos: Do consume the existing semantic CSS variables and preserve local font loading.
Do use canonical SVG signatures with their proportions and surrounding clear space intact.
Do show readable status text alongside color and retain distinct party approval states.
Do keep supplier and supporting metadata below the primary product title.
Do preserve visible focus, readable disabled text, reduced motion and forced-color affordances.
Do identify local demo activity, participant scope, five-second freshness and credential validity in plain text.
Do distinguish website identity linking from local MCP agent access.
donts: Don't use lime as an approval or success signal.
Don't redraw, retype, stretch or add effects to the logo.
Don't introduce gradients, glow, glass, decorative AI motifs or new accent colors.
Don't turn backend turn claims into agent connection-health indicators or treat demo orders as payment.
Don't imply that unrelated businesses' trades are visible or that a hosted OAuth MCP connector has been deployed.
